title: Daim Cheesecake
subtitle: Easy delicious no-bake Daim Cheesecake
description: Easy recipe for homemade Daim cheesecake with only 7 ingredients. Easy Daim cheesecake which is quick to make.

sections.name: Biscuit base
steps: Start by crushing your digestive biscuits. Tip: put your biscuits in a plastic bag and hit them with something hard: meat mallet, rolling pin, etc.
Melt butter (in a pot, or microwave). Mix your crumbled biscuits with the melted butter.
Get your springform pan ready. Find a springform pan. Line the bottom with baking paper.
Pour your biscuit and butter mixture into the springform pan and press it down well and out to the sides. Rest in the fridge as you make the cheese filling.

sections.name: Cream cheese filling
steps: Put all the ingredients (except Daim) for the filling in a bowl and beat with an electric whisk until the entire mixture turns into a uniform, firm cream.
Chop the Daim and fold it into the cream (save a little for garnish).
Refrigerate the cake for at least 5 hours, but preferably overnight. And voila!
